newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-MARADONA SAYS ARGENTINA ARE OUT OF THE WORLD CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MARADONA SAYS ARGENTINA ARE OUT OF THE WORLD CUP.

text.p: Diego Maradona says Argentina will fail to qualify for the World Cup after their dismal 1-1 draw at home to Chile on Sunday, the second time in a row they have failed to win at home.
"Argentina were not better than Chile and are out of the World Cup," Maradona said in a television programme on Monday.
"(Coach Daniel) Passarella talks about guts and determination and the team as a whole but the worst thing is that the team did not produce one single, well-trained move," he said.
Maradona also hit out at Passarella's hardline approach to discipline, which has included much-publicised bans on players having long hair and wearing earrings.
"What is the use of all this discipline?" he said.

Sunday's draw left Argentine third in the nine-team South American group, from which the top four qualify for France. However, only three points separate them and eighth-placed Bolivia and their next three games are all away.
Meanwhile, Argentina are eight points adrift of group leaders Colombia. They drew their previous home game 1-1 with Paraguay and have also lost away to Ecuador.
